description: Studio pipeline job type (decision 5, 2026-09-02): run one project epic on the execution substrate through the studio. The run-epic instance names the epic; the tk-studio-launch surface distills the epic SPEC and bootstraps the first story's task manifest at the planner tier, then starts bmad-loop detached with a pre-minted run id. One-shot: the engine owns the checkout after launch; its progress is read from the substrate's own run files, not from this job's run.
